title: Student Technology Loan Checklist
subtitle: Capture device serial, charger, acceptable use, and connectivity support; confirm repair route and end-of-term return.
description: Student Technology Loan records device serial, charger, acceptable use, connectivity support, repair route, and end-of-term return. Student Technology Loan evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this student technology loan stage-gated verification when staff must document device serial and charger. Reconcile acceptable use, connectivity support, repair route, and end-of-term return before the student technology loan handoff. Use the asset inventory, serial scan, charger and case count, acceptable-use agreement, connectivity request, help-desk ticket, repair estimate, and return inspection. Ask the assigned student technology loan reviewer to confirm device serial against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Student Technology Loan starting details
sections.guidance: Match device serial to charger and accessories; record acceptable-use receipt, connectivity need, filtering or access route, repair ticket, and end-of-term return.

blocks.label: Student Technology Loan people and reference

sections.title: Student Technology Loan checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current student technology loan facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Student Technology Loan required checks
items: Device serial is identified for this record
Charger matches the current request or source
Acceptable use is ready for point-of-use staff
Connectivity support limits or questions are resolved
Repair route is communicated to the responsible person
End-of-term return is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Student Technology Loan failed or pending items

sections.title: Student Technology Loan readiness
sections.guidance: Hold student technology loan readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.guidance: Student Technology Loan receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
